title: Adding three numbers by making ten
examples: How do I add three numbers?
Can I add numbers in any order?

explain.say: Tunde buys 6 oranges, then 5, then 4 more. How many in all? Here is a trick: look for two numbers that make 10. On the board you can see a full 10 and 5 more, which is 15. Let us see how we got there.

draw.text: Adding three numbers by making ten

explain.say: 6 and 4 are a number bond to 10! So add those first. See the 6 counters, and then 4 more fill the frame? 6 plus 4 is 10. Which number is still waiting?
Now add the 5 that was waiting. 10 plus 5 is 15, easy, because adding to 10 is simple. So 6 plus 5 plus 4 is 15. Did you notice we added them in a different order?
You can add numbers in any order and still get the same total. Try 7 plus 8 plus 3. Find the bond first: 7 and 3 make 10! Which number is left to add?
Super! 10 plus 8 is 18, so 7 plus 8 plus 3 is 18. Wow: market sellers from Lagos to Lima add prices this way, hunting for tens. Challenge: try 9 plus 6 plus 1!

faq.q: How do I add three numbers?
faq.a: Look for two numbers that make 10 and add them first. Then add the last number to 10. For 6 plus 5 plus 4, do 6 plus 4 is 10, then 10 plus 5 is 15.
asks: What is the easiest way to add three numbers?

faq.a: 6 plus 5 plus 4 is 15. Add 6 and 4 to make 10, then add 5.

faq.q: Can I add numbers in any order?
faq.a: Yes. Adding gives the same total whatever order you use. 6 plus 5 plus 4 and 6 plus 4 plus 5 both make 15.
asks: Does the order matter when adding?

faq.q: What if no two numbers make 10?
faq.a: Look for a double instead, like 4 plus 4, or add the two biggest first. For 3 plus 4 plus 4, double 4 is 8, then add 3 to get 11.
asks: What if there is no bond to 10?

faq.q: Can I subtract in any order too?
faq.a: No. Order matters in take away: 10 take away 4 is 6, but 4 take away 10 is not the same. Adding and multiplying can be swapped, but subtracting cannot.

facts: Numbers can be added in any order without changing the total.

quiz.say: Which two numbers should you add first in 8 plus 7 plus 2?
quiz.show: Which two numbers should you add first in 8 + 7 + 2?
quiz.why: 8 and 2 make 10, so the sum becomes 10 plus 7, which is 17.

wrong.0: 8 plus 7 is 15, which is harder to work with.
